notes.title: New Game Announcement and Enemy Steam Workshop Support!
notes.content:
[h1]New Game![/h1]
I'm happy to announce that I'm developing a new game. If you liked [i]Enemy[/i], I hope you'll consider supporting [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tomjohnson/ecosystem]Ecosystem[/url].
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7774679/68c4179f09ca19787f991ad502088c767b17d49e.png[/img]
[i]Ecosystem[/i] is a game about life and its interactions. At its heart are evolving virtual lifeforms, who grow from synthetic DNA and live in a physically-simulated ocean. This DNA encodes everything about a creature, from skeletal structure to skin, from joint-types to mental processes. A wide variety of different creature populations share a single environment, where they swim, graze, prey on each other, and have children. The fittest creatures pass their genes along to their children, and over time a world of strange and unique creatures is born.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7774679/d22295687683effe507f932927f29994a16a1c93.jpg[/img]

[h1]Enemy Steam Workshop Support![/h1]
This has been in the works for a long time: Enemy has support for Steam workshop! You can visit it right now at http://steamcommunity.com/app/339570/workshop/. You'll find new environments, enemies, recruits, and items there to add to your game, and you can also create your own and share them with other players. I hope this will make it easier for people to find the excellent mods that already exist, like Michaelullom's [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1328547972]8 Bit Enemy Mod[/url]  and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1328426584]Gamechu's Character Pack[/url], and also inspire people to create their own. I've played every mod for the game so far, and I'm excited to see what else the community can do.

Thanks for all of your support over the past few years.
Tom Johnson
